headline: ADI Milan internship describes power-IC modeling and metric-driven DMS/AMS verification training
fact: ADI posted AMS Design Verification Intern R267539 for its High-Performance Power Group in Milan, with a possible master’s thesis. The group designs display, lighting and cloud-power ICs. Advertised training covers verification planning, Verilog-AMS and SystemVerilog analog-block models, AMS simulations, state-machine checks, analog assertions and metric-driven SystemVerilog/UVM environments combining DMS and AMS at IP and top level. This records the current internship posting, not the launch of a new training program or completed student work.

sources.title: ADI Careers: AMS Design Verification Intern (R267539)
sources.summary: Official public Workday startDate is October 21, 2026. The full description names the Milan High-Performance Power Group, application areas and proposed training; applications remained enabled at this check. It does not assign AI-assisted modeling.
